Package com.neueda.leap.order.model

Class Fill

java.lang.Object
com.neueda.leap.order.model.Fill
@Entity public class Fill extends Object
Fill entity representing the execution of an order against a market quote. BR-02, BR-06: One fill per order in MVP (no partial fills). Quote identity and timestamp retain pricing evidence; freshness is checked by the execution service. BR-09: Fills trigger settlement ledger entries (holding movements and cash transactions).
